missions.title: FIRST CONTACT
missions.narrative: A routine night patrol becomes an unknown airspace incident. Three unidentified aircraft enter restricted airspace off the coast. Intercept them, identify each contact, and decide who is a threat before you fire.

intel.label: CENTRAL PICTURE
intel.text: Three tracks, no valid IFF. All tagged HOSTILE by the central picture.

intel.label: RADAR
intel.text: Coastal radar reports intermittent classification errors. Treat all tags as unverified.

intel.label: RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
intel.text: Visual identification required before weapons release. A civilian zone lies west of the base.

intel.label: SIGNALS
intel.text: One track is transmitting an unrecognised repeating message on a military band.

evidence.title: RECOVERED DATA BURST — SCOUT U-1
lines: KESTREL-7 FILED AS HOSTILE BY CENTRAL PICTURE 02:58

missions.title: GUARDIAN
missions.narrative: Escort a medical transport across contested Mediterranean airspace.

intel.label: CONVOY
intel.text: Single transport on a fixed corridor.

missions.title: RED VECTOR
missions.narrative: A fighter sweep enters the coastal sector. Win the fight.

missions.title: EAGLE EYE
missions.narrative: Photograph a suspected relay site hidden in the Atlas valleys.

intel.label: TARGET
intel.text: Valley relay site, marginal radar cover.

missions.title: DUST ROUTE
missions.narrative: Protect a ground column crossing the high plateaus.

missions.title: BROKEN WING
missions.narrative: A downed crew signals from the mountains. Cover the rescue.

missions.title: NO SIGNAL
missions.narrative: Navigate through jammed airspace with degraded radar.

missions.title: BLACK SAND
missions.narrative: Destroy a hidden VESPER relay site in the deep desert.

missions.title: MIRAGE
missions.narrative: A fast courier jet flees south. Run it down.

missions.title: NIGHT WATCH
missions.narrative: Night patrol turns to night combat over the dunes.

missions.title: STORM LINE
missions.narrative: Fight through a storm front over the Atlas.

missions.title: BLIND SKY
missions.narrative: Radar fails across the coast. Fly by eye.

missions.title: FALSE FLAG
missions.narrative: Identify who is real. Escort what is true.

missions.title: GREY
missions.narrative: One-on-one against the pilot called Grey.

missions.title: SHADOW LINE
missions.narrative: End VESPER’s operation before the line is crossed.
